cores.description: .md and .markdown files. Opens beside the workspace's agent, with live editing, presence and history.
cores.name: Markdown core

cores.description: Code, config, plain text, logs, HTML/XML/SVG and diagram sources, and CSV/TSV as text.
cores.name: Text and code core
cores.short: code, config, plain text, logs, CSV/TSV as text

cores.description: PSD, CAD, 3D and .blend files, images, PDFs, office files and the rest. These open the usual way, with a panel beside them: who's here, a lock, versions and restore, conflict copies and approvals.
cores.name: Any other file
cores.short: PSD, CAD, 3D and .blend files, images, PDFs and the rest: presence, a lock, versions

cores.description: A whiteboard Garden for you and your agents. Single-person for now. Off: Board Gardens show a placeholder and agents' k2 board calls are refused; your boards are kept.
cores.name: Board
cores.short: the Board Garden (a whiteboard for you and your agents)

cores.description: .pptx decks. Agents read and change slides and shapes with deck verbs (slide list, shape text, shape move), and a save from your presentation app is taken in by slide and shape. Decks still open the usual way: there's no live view yet. Off: a .pptx is an any-file doc.
cores.name: Slides core
cores.short: .pptx decks: slide and shape verbs for agents

cores.description: .otio, .fcpxml and .prproj video timelines. Agents read tracks, clips and markers, and change .otio timelines with clip and marker verbs; a save from your editing app is taken in by clip. Off: these are any-file docs.
cores.name: Timeline core
cores.short: .otio, .fcpxml and .prproj timelines: clip and marker verbs for agents

cores.description: Photoplot and drill files for circuit boards (.gbr, .drl and their layer files). Agents read apertures, features and holes, and compare versions; nobody writes them through K2. Off: these are any-file docs.
cores.name: PCB fabrication core
cores.short: photoplot and drill files: read-only feature and hole verbs for agents

cores.description: .blend scenes, read only for now. Agents read collections and objects, a save from your 3D app is taken in by object, and the scene's cameras and objects get previews. Editing .blend files through K2 comes in a later release. Off: a .blend is an any-file doc.
cores.name: 3D scene core
cores.short: .blend scenes (read only): object reads for agents, scene previews

welcome.read_only_reason: K2 can't save .blend edits yet; this file opens read-only.

error.hint: K2 can't save .blend edits yet; this file opens read-only.
